slice: periphery (6/10): daedalus/eval, daedalus/mapping, daedalus/memory, daedalus/observe, daedalus/wiki, daedalus/gui, daedalus/tools
summary: This slice is Daedalus's measurement-and-inspection periphery: eval/ is the evaluator boundary (Invariant 4), mapping/ is the generated architecture artifact that feeds the self-improvement picker, memory/ is the product-side journal plus its derived latent index, and observe/ wiki/ gui/ tools/ are four small, well-documented, test-covered capability probes. Documentation quality is unusually high - almost every module docstring states its own limits and cites the measurement that motivated it, and eval/ in particular is exemplary about self-grading and label provenance. Health is mixed by directory: eval/ and mapping/ are genuinely wired into daedalus/spine (attempt.py, picker.py) and daedalus/cli.py, while observe/, wiki/, gui/ and tools/ are complete, tested islands with zero production consumers. The dominant structural gap is Gate 0's centralized start/guard path: every effectful CLI in this slice that IS registered in daedalus/spine/effect_boundary.py carries Wiring.INVENTORY_ONLY, and several effectful entrypoints (project-memory, tools inventory, python -m daedalus.eval) are not registered at all - including memory/embeddings.py's direct urllib egress to Ollama, which bypasses sensitivity.lane_for_host entirely.

INVARIANT 8, egress: daedalus/memory/embeddings.py:340-347 performs a raw urllib POST to a caller-supplied Ollama host without consulting sensitivity.lane_for_host, while daedalus/tools/vet.py:44 states that host policy 'has exactly one implementation'. Two different rules for bytes leaving the machine.

INVARIANT 4, evaluator seal: daedalus/eval/correctness.py and daedalus/spine/attempt.py import each other (attempt.py:1129-1137 uses a function-local import purely to break the cycle). The evaluator and the runner it grades are mutually dependent modules; the seal is maintained by worktree isolation, not by module topology.

INVARIANT 3/4, provenance check coverage: eval/provenance.check_import_provenance is called only from kairos/evolution.py:7. spine/attempt.py - the canonical attempt path - does not call it, so the 'did the evaluator score the candidate's tree' question is answered on one path and assumed on the other.

CAPABILITY GATE UNWIRED: daedalus/tools/vet.py has no production caller. daedalus/skills.py parses SKILL.md and daedalus/control_plane.py enumerates .mcp.json, and neither consults the verdict - so a capability can be handed to an agent without the gate that was written for exactly that moment ever running.

KNOWLEDGE PLANE HAS NO INGEST: daedalus/wiki/{vault,links}.py parse [[code:...]] and [[type:...]] edges that docs/wiki/*.md already contain, but no importer exists and daedalus/web_api.py serves no knowledge route. The Twin's Knowledge plane is implemented and disconnected at both ends.
OBSERVED-PROVENANCE EDGES HAVE NO CONSUMER: daedalus/observe/shape.py produces exactly the observed-lineage records plan section 5 describes, and nothing in structcore/ or spine/ ingests them.

DARK-BY-DEFAULT EVIDENCE: mapping/spectral.py is wired only behind include_spectral=False (picker.py:2224, lazy import at :2304) - by mapping/switches.py's own definition a dark feature, i.e. the module that measures darkness contains one.

STALE GENERATED AUTHORITY: docs/architecture-state.json records head 7955317/dirty=true against HEAD c264f5dd. drift.digest_ok (picker.py:1017) detects hand-editing but not staleness, so the self-improvement picker can rank work from a snapshot several commits old without any signal.
notable: Documentation-in-code quality in this slice is the highest I have seen in the tree: eval/tasks.py, eval/mint.py, eval/harness.py and eval/report.py collectively refuse to blend self-graded 'hand_reachable' recall with independently minted labels, and report.py:13-31 prints the disclaimer on every render. That is Invariant 9 implemented as a code path, not a promise.

eval/mutate.py's docstring argues against its own author's earlier result ('graph_delta reached 12/12 ... but only after two layers were ADDED specifically to catch the defects the first layers missed ... That is fitting to the test set'). Retained negative evidence in exactly the shape AGENTS.md section 5 asks for.

eval/ceiling.py computes a deliberately LEAKY arm alongside the clean one so the size of the self-prediction artefact is measured rather than argued. Lane A2 was closed on the clean 2.3% and the reopen condition is a rerun of this module - a kill criterion with a working switch.

eval/provenance.py distinguishes 'candidate scored 0' from 'evaluation could not run' and calls conflating them the actual bug. That distinction is the correct reading of Invariant 4 and it is enforced in code.

vet.py's uncommitted hardening is unusually disciplined: it keeps the (?<![\w.]) lookbehind on exec.eval on purpose and instead names dangerous namespaces exactly (builtins.eval, os.execv, pty.spawn), with the rationale written inline - strictness bought without a false-positive flood that trains humans to ignore the gate. exec.powershell_iex is REVIEW not BLOCK for the same reason.

mapping/ exists because a hand-written inventory listed 136 features / 8 islands / 2 dark switches where a deep read six hours later found 827 / 55 / 51. Every module in the package restates that number as its justification. The current generated state reports 144 modules / 8 islands / 12 unreached / 0 dark switches - the counts have converged, which is itself evidence the generated half is working.

STALE DOCSTRING: daedalus/eval/__init__.py:1-22 still describes eval/ as the two-tier distillation harness only. Six modules added since (correctness, mint, mutate, graph_delta, ceiling, provenance) are invisible in the package's stated scope - a reader taking the facade at its word would conclude this repo has no correctness evaluator, which was true before correctness.py and is the exact misconception that module was written to end.
daedalus/gui/__init__.py is 0 bytes - the only package in the slice with no scope docstring, in a tree where every other __init__ carries one.

wiki/__init__.py names the precise reason the write path is blocked ('kairos.gated_writes is a provider-attempt pipeline, not a write fence, and wiring a human editor's PUT through it would fail every save silently'). That is a correct refusal to reuse a mechanism for a purpose it does not serve - the opposite of the drift AGENTS.md warns about.

Three separate modules in this slice (tools/vet.py:44, tools/inventory.py 'WHAT IT DOES NOT DO', wiki/__init__.py) independently refuse to bolt routing or provisioning onto themselves and name provider_router as the single lane-policy owner. The 'do not mint a second control plane' rule is being followed voluntarily at the module level.
